summary.text: Ronald (Ron) C. Russell is the Republican nominee for Maine's 1st Congressional District and a defense contractor from Kennebunkport. A West Point attendee and Army Special Forces veteran who describes himself as a native Mainer and business owner, he lost to Rep. Chellie Pingree in 2024 and won the 2026 Republican primary for a rematch.

paragraphs.text: Russell grew up on his family's potato farm in northern Maine and describes himself as a native Mainer.
Ballotpedia lists him as born in Fort Fairfield, Maine, and as a 1976 graduate of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point who served in the U.S. Army until 2006.
In his own words he served 30 years in the military as an Airborne Ranger and Special Forces Green Beret.
After his military service Russell lived in the South, started a small operations and intelligence business, and worked about 15 years as a Department of Defense contractor.
Ballotpedia describes his career as including work for a defense contractor and later co-owning another company.
Russell returned to Maine to run for office; he is a Kennebunkport resident and had not held elected office before 2024.
He won the 2024 Republican primary over Andrew Piantidosi and lost the November 2024 general election to Pingree by more than 20 points.
He won the June 9, 2026 Republican primary over Joshua James Pietrowicz.
